article-details.looks: A blog article's header (title, author, date, tags, header image under an optional overlay, and an optional navy side panel to the right of the title) and its body of text and image items.
article-details.use: Only on blog pages, which the backend generates.

fields.headerImage: The header image; the blog's thumbnail elsewhere on the site comes from it.
fields.heroContentPosition: left (default), center or right for the title over the header image.

fields.bodyText: A run of article copy: paragraphs, lists, sub-headings and links.

article-hero-panel.use: Optional, one per blog: a call to action beside the blog title, like the page Hero's side panel.

fields.panelTitle: Short panel heading, e.g. 'Need help now?'.
fields.panelText: One or two short paragraphs; the first shows larger and bold.
fields.panelPrimaryText: Words on the main button, with panelPrimaryLink.
fields.panelSecondaryText: Optional text link under the button, with panelSecondaryLink.
fields.panelFooterText: Optional small print at the bottom.
